method.capacity: Live probes through each module's public entry points, every case from an empty namespace inside one lock hold. Oracles: exact read-back (length and SHA-256) through the module's own reader and by SQL; the IRIS journal's net effect of the failing call (row-id counters, IVG version/generation stamps and the rdf_props iFind word dictionary excluded as non-transactional by design) to tell a clean refusal from a partial write; rows vs ^KG out/in/label vs temporal reads vs get_node for widths. Cases: key widths by bisection per writer (cap_width.py), value sizes at column widths and at the 3,641,144-character long-string limit (cap_values.py), ledger records near the limit through every reader of 11/13/14/18 (cap_records.py), BM25 tokens and document ids near the subscript limit (cap_bm25.py), batch sizes, whole-window string readers, IRIS lock escalation with a second process, redaction batch size against a concurrent committer (cap_batch.py), setup re-run over data (setup_rerun.py), snapshot client memory against content size (snapshot_mem.py). Module 09 by inspection only.
method.keys: keys.py: after each module's writer sequences (sequential duplicates, in-batch duplicates, repeated loads, racing writers on separate connections released by a barrier, delete then re-create, multigraph, merge/replace restores), K1 no duplicate declared key by %IGNOREINDEX * full scans (sees %NOINDEX/%NOCHECK rows), K2 ^KG out/in and label index equal to the rows, K3 edge ids distinct; 01 compares the DDL's declared constraints with INFORMATION_SCHEMA. Follow-ups: race_edge.py (8 trials x 2 variants), temporal_count.py and temporal_race.py.
method.fk: fk.py: F1 edge endpoints, F2 labels, F3 properties (no declared FK), F4 node embeddings, F5 ^KG out/in and label index endpoints, F6 ^KG tout endpoints, F7 rdf_reifications edge and reifier node, by full scans after each module's delete and write paths.

self_test: selftest.py (run st-control-capkeys-selftest): eval_keys and eval_fk report nothing on clean synthetic states and exactly the seeded condition on 7 + 9 seeded states; classify gives all 7 value outcomes; the counter filter keeps row nodes out; live, kg_leaves reads seeded ^IVGAuditDKeys leaves exactly (scratch removed), scan_from uses %IGNOREINDEX *, a product-written graph gives no violation. The live capacity cases also carry their own positive controls: the temporal writer's documented partial (F-C0501) is flagged as residue, and the Cypher relationship-property loss is flagged as silent loss.

not_findings.lock-escalation: A caller transaction holding more than about 1,000 row inserts in one table escalates to a table lock (IRIS LockThreshold); for its duration every other process's write to that table, any graph, waits 10 s and fails with SQLCODE -110 'nothing written' (st-live-cap-batch). The product's answers stay consistent; no IVG document states whether one graph's transaction may block another graph's writers. Reported as intent-undecided, no finding id.
not_findings.temporal-count-once: st-live-keys read a count aggregate of 4 for 3 events after a combined sequence; 18 isolated trials did not repeat it (st-live-keys-temporal-count, st-live-keys-temporal-race).
